'''2013 Worlds Day 3 Vikram Bali LS Sai'torr Kal Fas (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Vikram Bali]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 3).

Typed 2013 Xerox Print Form. Username DVD ROTS. Line 43 Sense & Recoil In Fear struck, handwritten Sense. Line 59 Sorry About The Mess & Blaster Proficiency struck, handwritten Clash Of Sabers.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Sai'torr Kal Fas (V) (Virtual Block 1)|Sai'torr Kal Fas (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
